TransportLinkANPRDynamic.description: ANPR-reported live measurement for a transport link.

transportLinkId.description: Identifier of the transport link this reading is about.
transportLinkId.title: ObjectId

quality.description: Optional quality statement for this measurement.

averageSpeedKph.description: Estimated average speed in kilometres per hour.

linkTravelTimeSeconds.description: Current link journey time in seconds.

kind.description: Discriminator for the tagged union. The fixed value "anpr" selects the TransportLinkANPRDynamic payload; it is not free-text command content.

numberPlatesIn.description: Number of successful plate reads at the start of the link.

numberPlatesOut.description: Number of successful plate reads at the end of the link.

numberPlatesMatches.description: Count of number-plate matches in the measurement period.

numberPlatesMatchesUsed.description: Number of successful matches actually used in the travel-time calculation.

extensions.description: Vendor or local extensions. Open-content object.

TransportLinkGPSDynamic.description:
GPS-probe live measurement for a transport link.

Field set drawn from the XSD TransportLinkGpsDynamicGroup (Freeflow
Extension): CurrentJourneyTime, the three travel-time statistics
(Mean/Median/VarianceTravelTime), NumberOfVehicles and the reserved-
lane flow count. Shared base fields (transport_link_id, timestamp,
quality, average_speed_kph, link_travel_time_seconds) are inherited
from _TransportLinkDynamicBase.

transportLinkId.description: Identifier of the transport link this reading is about.
transportLinkId.title: ObjectId

quality.description: Optional quality statement for this measurement.

averageSpeedKph.description: Estimated average speed in kilometres per hour.

linkTravelTimeSeconds.description: Current link journey time in seconds.

kind.description: Discriminator for the tagged union. The fixed value "gps" selects the TransportLinkGPSDynamic payload; it is not free-text command content.

meanTravelTimeSeconds.description: Mean travel time along the link in the measured interval, in seconds.

medianTravelTimeSeconds.description: Median travel time along the link in the measured interval, in seconds.

varianceTravelTimeSeconds.description: Variance of travel times along the link in the measured interval. The unit is seconds squared (s²), as for any variance of times; the field name keeps 'Seconds' for compatibility with v1.

numberOfVehicles.description: Number of vehicles in the measured interval.

reservedLaneFlowVehicles.description: Flow in the reserved lane in the measured interval, in vehicles. A rate, so it may be fractional.

extensions.description: Vendor or local extensions. Open-content object.

TransportLinkSCOOTDynamic.description: SCOOT-reported live measurement for a transport link.

transportLinkId.description: Identifier of the transport link this reading is about.
transportLinkId.title: ObjectId

quality.description: Optional quality statement for this measurement.

averageSpeedKph.description: Estimated average speed in kilometres per hour.

linkTravelTimeSeconds.description: Current link journey time in seconds.

kind.description: Discriminator for the tagged union. The fixed value "scoot" selects the TransportLinkSCOOTDynamic payload; it is not free-text command content.

congestionPercent.description: Current percentage congestion as reported by SCOOT.

currentFlowVehicles.description: Current flow in vehicles over the SCOOT measurement interval. A rate, so it may be fractional (e.g. a smoothed or averaged flow).

occupancyPercent.description: Average link occupancy percentage across all detectors on the link.

extensions.description: Vendor or local extensions. Open-content object.
